scope: Read-only readiness audit before enabling production coordination

blockers.finding: Opaque hook failures retain ownership when environment changes are not proven. Current hooks protocol has no stopped result and resolve_unknown_hook unconditionally rejects ConfirmStopped, leaving this failed job without a proven-stop recovery path.
blockers.required_before_enable: Implement independently verified stopped-job/environment reconciliation to a failed or needs-attention outcome, explicit retry, and subprocess crash/restart acceptance. Do not clear the database or fabricate a successful receipt.

blockers.finding: Each observation of the same failed hook repeats both the unknown transition and identical error log.
blockers.required_before_enable: Persist state changes and new executor log records, deduplicate unchanged observation results, and verify bounded growth during a persistent failure.

remaining_production_integration.needed: Create a separate production adapter/configuration with frozen immutable source/image, explicit component and backup scope, rollout/digest/readiness verification, existing rollback/source snapshot protections, and separately scoped credentials.

safety: No deploy, cancellation, forced unlock, database mutation, credential change, or production lane activation performed.
